Poisoned BladesBasicExclusive Lv.2
Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single enemy, with a 100% chance to inflict [Deep Poisoning I] for 2 turns.

Restoration BottleActive
Restores all allies' HP by 8% of Max HP plus 60% of Wolsey's ATK.
Poison TreatmentPassiveExclusive Lv.1
Restores all allies' HP by 2.6% of Max HP each time Wolsey actively attacks 1 target under [Poison] status.
Recovery Poisoned Blade Lv.1The more enemy targets under [Poison] status, the higher Healing Effect Wolsey has, up to 40% more Healing Effect.
Toxic BottleActiveExclusive Lv.3
Deals 200% ATK DMG to all enemies and additionally triggers [Poison] 1 time (up to 6 layers of [Poison] can be triggered each time). Meanwhile, reduces the ATK by 20% from targets under [Poison] status for 2 turns. If the target is not under [Poison] status, inflicts a layer of [Poison] instead for 2 turns.
